body: Fix as a global observer On<Despawn, TnuaSensorsSet> in CharacterPlugin that try_despawns the set's sources (what linked_spawn would do). Rejected: vendoring bevy-tnua-physics-integration-layer to add linked_spawn (second vendored crate for one attribute); On<Remove, Character> (tied to our marker, not to the Tnua relation, and Remove also fires on component removal without despawn).
